name: profile-card
title: Profile Card
description: Follow the profile to see the count and actions change
useCases: In a mentor directory, a student opens a conversation with a particular mentor. The app receives the name through onMessage.
In a community, a reader follows an author from their profile card. The app persists the follow state.
task: Follow the profile to see the count and actions change
behavior: Supply name and role. onMessage receives the name for opening a conversation and onFollow receives the new follow state.
